preparation: Direct Bezier tracing of the supplied artwork. SVG masters contain only paths, with no embedded bitmap. Android uses VectorDrawable; iOS uses a vector-preserving SVG image asset. Store/legacy icons are raster exports from these masters.
spellingCorrection: HYMNLOGY corrected to HYMNOLOGY using existing SVG glyphs; tagline follows the original theme-aware logo ink. All artwork outside the corrected word is unchanged.
